headline: Renner Reports Better-Than-Expected Q3 Net Income of R$ 187 Million, Drops Guidance
summary: Renner posted a third-quarter net income of R$ 187 million, beating expectations, while net revenue fell 1.6% and same-store sales dropped 2.5% amid weaker consumer demand and international competition.
why: Retail earnings reports demonstrate the impact of fierce international platform competition and shifting consumer purchasing power on domestic profit margins.

impacts.name: Lojas Renner SA
impacts.why: Better-than-expected net income supports valuation, but dropping revenue projections highlights top-line uncertainty.
